address: 54F, Conrad Hotel, 186 Yanwu West Road, Siming, Xiamen, China Mainland
bio: This upscale restaurant in a towering hotel commands breathtaking views of Gulangyu. Head to the romantic bar for a pre-dinner drink and watch the lights dim as the sun sets. Those craving the classics can order steak or seafood tower à la carte. If you're feeling adventurous, go for the tasting menu, which features innovative seasonal dishes – creations made with local catch such as yellowtail scad and fourfinger threadfin are especially impressive....
